units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 82b:18">B. Kam. 82ᵇ</cite> <he>חָכְמַת י׳</he> the principle of Greek culture (philosophy, ethics, religion &c.).
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 83a:1">Ib. 83ᵃ</cite> <he>לשון י׳</he> Greek language, distinguished fr. <he>חכמת י׳</he>.
Meg. 9ᵃ התירו יונית permitted the use of a Greek translation. Y. ib. I, 71ᶜ top, v. בָּדָא; a. fr.—V. לָשׁוֹן.—Pl. יְוָנִים, יְוָו׳ Greeks (mostly of the Syrian government).

<cite ref="Megillah 11a:11">Meg. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>בימי י׳</he> in the days of the Greeks (of Antiochus Epiphanes and successors); Esth. R., beg. <cite ref="I00893"><he>טרקווינוס</he></cite> (corr. acc.).
